name: Red Hat Shelton Challenge
what_you_do: A six-day program where you stay on campus. It has ropes courses, service projects and group activities. They teach you about fair choices, talking with others and setting goals.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page does not state grade levels. It says needs-based scholarships are available.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are coming soon on the program site. The page does not list a 2027 deadline. Alumni can attend a one-day re-Challenge on Saturday, Nov 21, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Learn More and Apply link on the Shelton Challenge site for the Red Hat Shelton Challenge at NC State. Other partner sites run the same program in other places.
notes: Dates are last year's. Check sheltonleadership.ncsu.edu/shelton-challenge-programs for 2027 dates.
